content: How close is our facial nerve mesh to the dataset's published mesh?

name: search_docs

content: Documentation: 5 passage(s) for 'How close is our facial nerve mesh to the dataset's published mesh?'

For specimen ZETA (right side), the facial nerve mesh lies on average **0.049 mm** from the dataset's published mesh [S4].

| Metric | Value |
| --- | --- |
| Mean surface distance | 0.049 mm |
| 95th percentile | 0.075 mm |
| Maximum | 0.344 mm |

This means the closest points between our mesh and the dataset's published mesh are within ~0.05 mm on average, with occasional outliers up to 0.34 mm [S4]. 

The validation confirms that CochleaHub's surface meshes lie on average 0.05–0.1 mm from the dataset's published meshes [S3]. This is consistent with the pipeline version 0.1.0 run for specimen ZETA [S1].

Note: CochleaHub uses the dataset's segmentation as given and does not perform independent anatomical validation [S3].
